svg.title: Where ctxpipe fits in a software factory
svg.desc: A stack of four layers. What you ship: your products and features. Agents and tools, which are yours: Claude Code, Cursor, review bots, internal agents. Context, which is ctxpipe in your git: what your org knows, kept current. Models, which are rented and swappable: Claude, GPT, Gemini, open weights. Switch models or agents. The knowledge stays where it is.
